title: Chat: Presence, Typing Indicators, and Message Queue
description: Add online presence, typing indicators, and reliable message delivery with queues.

data.text: Add online/offline presence, typing indicators, and guarantee message delivery even when the recipient is offline. Use message queues for scalability.

data.title: PresenceService and TypingTracker
Why Redis for chat?
data.text: Redis Pub/Sub handles real-time message broadcasting. Redis Sorted Sets store message history with timestamps as scores for efficient range queries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Typing indicators expire after 3 seconds of inactivity
Message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka) buffer messages for offline users
data.takeaway: Chat reliability comes from queues and presence tracking. Presence is connection-based. Delivery is queue-based. Together they make chat feel instant and reliable.
